messages:
sophia: Putting together a lightweight selection rubric for the next DP cohort. Goal: pick ~20 partners balanced across: high-volume chat, embeddings-heavy, and private infra. Quick thoughts?
raj: Love it. Key ask: include a "time-to-first-success" signal in rubric (how fast they can get a sample query running). That's our shortest path to value.
evan: Agree. Propose rubric dimensions (score 1-5): 1) Integration speed, 2) Use-case alignment, 3) Willingness to run experiments, 4) Data sensitivity, 5) Support bandwidth.
nicole: Can we add a channel-level preference? e.g., prefer customers already on Dedicated or interested in Private. That reduces infra churn.
sophia: Yes. Draft weights: Integration speed 30%, Use-case 25%, Experiment willingness 20%, Data sensitivity 15%, Support bandwidth 10%. Thoughts?
raj: Minor tweak: flip data sensitivity and experiment willingness for regulatory-heavy sectors. Maybe add a tag system so we can reweight per cohort.
evan: Good call. We'll make weights configurable per cohort. Also: success criteria for pilot -> concrete pass/fail so we can graduate partners or escalate.
nicole: Suggested success criteria (binary + numeric): a) Completed onboarding checklist within 7 days (Y/N) b) >1000 tokens/day avg during active window OR b2) completed 3 targeted prompts for embeddings or chat c) qualitative NPS >= 7 on quick survey.
sophia: Add retention/upgrade signal: expressed interest in Dedicated/Private pilot within 30 days. That will be a business success metric.
ops-bot: bot: Created cohort tag `dp-cohort-apr2026` and tracking stub. Use `dp:tag=dp-cohort-apr2026` on invites.
raj: Feedback ingestion: we should capture structured feedback via 1) checklist fields, 2) short 3-question survey, and 3) optional freeform. Pipeline: webhook -> data lake -> curated table -> triage board.
evan: On the triage board, propose labels: bug, UX, performance, docs, feature-request. Triage SLA: 48h for assignment, 5 business days for initial response.
nicole: Compensation: small stipend vs voucher? Operationally vouchers are easier. Legal asked for a simple consent blurb. Suggested text: "Participants will receive a $75 voucher for completing the pilot checklist and survey."
sophia: We'll keep it $75 for this run. Also run a small A/B next quarter on stipend vs voucher if we have budget. For now single-arm.
raj: Timeline proposal: Invite send Apr 6, cohort onboarding window Apr 13-20, active pilot Apr 13-27 (14 days), wrap report by May 4. Does that align with infra capacity?
evan: Eng capacity looks fine but require canary support for pinning flow on Apr 12. Please flag if rollout collides with other deploys.
nicole: I'll prepare invite copy and consent language. Also will include a short onboarding playbook with screenshots.
sophia: Measurement dashboard items: onboarding_complete_rate, avg_tokens_14d, checklist_completion_rate, qual_nps, upgrade_intent_count. We'll compare to prior DP baseline.
raj: One more ask: add a small automated nudge flow: day 2 welcome, day 4 help offer (CS), day 10 reminder to complete checklist. Use outreach-runner; ops-bot can create sequences.
ops-bot: bot: Outreach sequence `dp-apr2026-nudges` created. Commands: `/outreach start dp-apr2026-nudges --cohort=dp-cohort-apr2026`
evan: Ok to close if product, CS, and legal sign-off by EOD Wed. I'll schedule the canary support window once signoffs done.
sophia: Summarizing action items: Nicole - invite + consent; Raj - dashboard + triage board; Evan - canary support schedule; Sophia - finalize rubric & participant list. We'll reconvene Fri for final sign-off.
nicole: Copy, will drop draft invites by Tue.
